0022600128.text: The Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) sit 5th in the Atlantic and 14th in the East, while the Celtics (2-1, on a two-game winning streak) are 2nd in the Atlantic, half a game back. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, most recently beating Brooklyn 148-111 in Boston on February 27, 2026. Tyler Bilodeau is out with a shoulder sprain and Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision for the Nets, while Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness.
